note: Track packs for sale (Moses, 12 Nov 2026): the price of every pack, kept here so a campaign can change it without code changes (the server, the website and the apps all read this file). priceCents: the website price (USD, VAT included; Stripe shows it in the player's own currency, as the coin packs). storeAmountCents: the US price set for the products in App Store Connect and Play Console (each store sets other countries itself). withCoins: the same pack paid partly with coins: at most maxCoinShare of the price in coins (coins are worth coinValueCentsPer1000 cents a thousand, as in the coin packs: 1,000 coins = $1), the rest in real money; a pack is never sold for coins alone. Its store products are the pack's id + '-coins'. fullAt: a pack goes on sale once it has this many live tracks; until then it shows as Coming soon. planned: the names of tracks still to come, shown on a pack's page.
